Posterior density from the target terms

Source: R/binomial_lattice_fast.R
lattice_power_prior_density_from_terms.Rd

sum_i a_i b_{i+k} T(i, k) over the source rows kept, with T(i, k) = sum_j w(i - j) c_j t_{j+k} the target terms of binomial_power_prior_target_terms(): the same double sum as lattice_power_prior_density(), summed over the target control rate first.

Usage

lattice_power_prior_density_from_terms(
  terms,
  source_control,
  source_treatment,
  source_rows,
  differences
)

Arguments

terms

The N x K matrix T, zero where i + k leaves the lattice except at the edges of a block.

source_control, source_treatment

Discounted source likelihoods on the lattice, the control one zero on the source rows left out.

differences

Risk differences, consecutive, in lattice units.

Value

The unnormalised density at differences.
